QuestInfo.name: Trainer's Command
QuestInfo.0: Pet Trainer Bartos told me if I can prove to him that I am capable of handling pets, then he'll teach me a secret method to handle more than one type of pet...I should visit the Pet Park over in Henesys (by entering through the hidden portal near the Cat statue).
QuestInfo.1: In order to learn various commands, I'll have to give Bartos the Pet Snack. Hmm, he mentioned a bigger store...
QuestInfo.2: I finally learned the secrets of commanding multiple pets through Bartos.  I shall display my talent to the world!
